description:
Collection of three vintage ladies' Bulova wristwatches featuring distinctive case designs, decorative detailing, and assorted metal bracelets.
Left: Benrus watch with elongated oval-shaped case, champagne-tone dial, gold-tone hands, and decorative curved accents with small clear stones. Narrow expansion-style bracelet. Marked 10K RGP (rolled gold plate).
Center: Bulova watch featuring a cushion-shaped case, champagne-tone dial with mixed Arabic numeral and baton hour markers, red seconds hand, and two-tone expansion-style bracelet. Marked 10K RGP (rolled gold plate).
Right: Vintage Bulova watch featuring a hexagonal case, textured gold-tone bezel, dark dial with gold-tone hands and hour markers, decorative clear stone accents, and intricately woven double-strand bracelet with folding clasp. Case back marked 14K, with N1 date code indicating 1971.
All three watches display vintage character and age-related surface wear. Gold content of the bracelets and authenticity of decorative stones have not been independently verified. The 10K RGP markings indicate rolled gold plate, not solid 10K gold.
Condition: Vintage preowned condition with visible surface wear and discoloration consistent with age. Working condition, timekeeping accuracy, and service history have not been verified. Sold as pictured.

Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.

Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition

The lot is in very good vintage condition. The teal Hemingray insulator shows typical minor chipping and roughness along the drip points on the base, which is characteristic of utility-grade glass. The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.

description:
Hemingray Glass Company
No. 45 Glass Insulator
Pressed Glass, Clear, Vintage
A classic piece of American industrial history, this Hemingray No. 45 glass insulator was a standard component for telegraph and telephone lines during the 20th century. These insulators are sought after by collectors for their sculptural form and historical significance in the expansion of communication infrastructure. The No. 45 model features a robust double-petticoat design intended for high-performance electrical isolation.
Double petticoat construction for electrical insulation integrity
Clear glass with a subtle light aqua tint characteristic of period glass production
Embossed "HEMINGRAY - 45" marking prominently on the lower base skirt
Approximately 3.75 inch base diameter and 4 inch total height
Condition:
Excellent vintage condition with no major chips or structural cracks. Inner and outer petticoats are intact. Original gloss is well-preserved with minor surface scratches consistent with age and utility service. Threaded core is clean and undamaged.

shipping.policy:
We are NOT responsible for packages lost, stolen, or damaged in transit. You will need to handle your own claims through the associated shipping carrier. We can provide necessary documentation if requested.
Items from our location will ship within 5-7 business days from the time payment is received. Our hours of operation are Monday through Friday from approximately 7am-3pm EST.
Buy It Now Non-Auction items and Stock Items are not eligible for combined shipping.
All other items may be combined for payment and shipping if they are from the same Goodwill location, close within 7 days of each other, are not marked as Cannot Be Combined For Shipping, do not exceed 20 lbs in combined weight and are being shipped via the same carrier.
To combine eligible auction items into one order, you must wait until all of the items have ended before paying.
Once the auctions have ended, please sign into your ShopGoodwill.com account and proceed to your Open Orders. Click on the Pay link next to one of the items, all auction items that may be eligible for combination will then be displayed. Click on the box next to each item and follow the instructions to complete your payment.
Once payment has been made for an item, it cannot be combined with another item won at a later date. If you have won an item and expect to win another from the same seller and wish to combine all items, you must postpone payment until you have won the second item (third, fourth item, etc.) but not exceeding 7 days from the closing date of the first item.
Due to the fragility and size and/or weight of certain items, the seller may not offer combined shipping for certain items. Please be sure to read all item descriptions carefully for any other item combination restrictions.
Items that have been paid for will be shipped to the address on file and will not be able to be modified or combined. Address changes, shipping cost adjustments, and/or alternative packaging requests MUST be submitted prior to payment. PO Boxes can be added to your profile address if one of our shipping carriers does not deliver to your physical address. We cannot edit profiles; please be sure this is done prior to making any purchases. Alternative packaging requests are subject to an additional fee where applicable.
In the event of an unclaimed pickup order, or a returned package, the customer will need to pay an additional shipping charge to re-ship the order. Under NO circumstances will a refund be given for said unclaimed/returned packages.
Any and all changes/adjustments MUST be made PRIOR to payment! Adjustments WILL NOT be made after a payment has been submitted. This location is closed on weekends & holidays. We may not be able to get to your support ticket right away. Please plan in advance.

Natural and Polished Rocks, 26 Pieces
This collection includes 26 geological specimens featuring raw crystals, mineral blocks, and polished stones. The lot offers a variety of textures, including quartz clusters, rose quartz, and jasper specimens, ideal for collectors and educational displays.
26 pieces including a large quartz cluster and needle-like crystal specimen
Features rose quartz, selenite, and various jasper specimens
Mixture of natural crystalline, rough, and tumbled stone finishes
Total weight: 7 lbs; approximately 26 items total
Condition:

Please note, one bookend has a small chip at the bottom edge, with general light surface wear consistent with previous display and handling. Description:
Elevate your decor or antique collection with this set of 5 vintage clear glass telephone pole insulators. The insulators show minor discoloration and wear consistent with age and previously serving functional use on utility poles. Offered as a matching set, these utility glass insulators bring industrial charm to any shelf or workspace. The heavyweight material ensures durability, while the transparency highlights their utilitarian design and historic appeal. Whether used for upcycling, display, or as conversation pieces, these insulators are a practical addition to any vintage decor. All five insulators are in used condition, with visible signs of prior use such as minor dirt, clouding, and scratches. Combined Shipping Policy:

Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

The formation captures light across its textured surface, highlighting the geometric precision of the mineral's growth habit.

This comprehensive collection features a diverse array of geological specimens and decorative stone objects, weighing a total of 7.8 pounds. The lot is anchored by a significant piece of cobalt blue cullet or slag glass, prized for its intense coloration and characteristic glassy conchoidal fracture. Accompanying the raw specimens is a curated selection of polished tumbled stones, including rose quartz, snowflake obsidian, amethyst, and iron pyrite, providing a broad survey of mineral textures and colors. A polished green stone egg and a set of stone-topped picks add a decorative functional element to the assembly.
Set of 9 metal decorative forks/picks featuring various stone cabochon handles including carnelian and quartz
Wide variety of minerals ranging from raw crystalline quartz and field specimens to polished aventurine and obsidian
Substantial cobalt blue slag glass specimen with characteristic swirling textures and vibrant translucency

description:
Polished Gemstone & Crystal Collection
Natural Mineral Specimens
Total Weight: 2.2 lbs
This diverse collection features a variety of natural mineral specimens, centered around a large clear-to-cloudy quartz crystal cluster. The assortment includes a white satin spar (selenite) wand, a clear faceted quartz point, and an array of polished tumbled stones in a spectrum of colors including blue, pink, purple, and earth tones. Ideal for geological study, home decor, or as a foundational set for mineral collectors.
Large quartz crystal cluster with visible prismatic terminations
Satin spar (selenite) wand with characteristic fibrous silky luster
Clear faceted quartz crystal point
Assortment of approximately 15 polished tumbled stones in various sizes and colors

title: Hemingray 42 Glass Insulator Set 2 Aqua Blue Green CD 154 Made in USA Vintage
description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Condition:
Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. As is common with authentic vintage insulators, there are minor fleabites and small chips along the sharp drip points on the beaded base. No large structural cracks or major damage to the wire grooves or top domes observed.
